description: This PHP source file defines the Aws\Budgets\BudgetsClient class, a client for interacting with the AWS Budgets service. It includes method annotations for various API calls related to budgets, notifications, and subscribers, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: BudgetsClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Budgets service, extending AwsClient, with methods to manage budgets, notifications, and subscribers.

methods.name: createBudget
methods.description: Creates a new budget in AWS.

methods.name: createBudgetActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new budget action.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates a new notification for a budget.

methods.name: createSubscriber
methods.description: Creates a new subscriber for a notification.

methods.name: describeBudget
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForAccount
methods.description: Describes budget actions for an account.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes budget actions for an account.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForBudget
methods.description: Describes actions for a specific budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetActionsForBudgetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes actions for a specific budget.

methods.name: describeBudgetNotificationsForAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists notifications for an account.

methods.name: describeBudgetPerformanceHistory
methods.description: Provides performance history of a budget.

methods.name: describeNotificationsForBudget
methods.description: Lists notifications for a specific budget.

methods.name: describeNotificationsForBudgetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists notifications for a budget.

methods.name: describeSubscribersForNotificationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists subscribers for a notification.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
